_doc: M3-CRE-611 review stage (wildlife_stage.tscn): the three kinds at close range in the creature stage's noon light. A low flock over two posts (two birds start perched), a beach of crabs beside the stand-in player (the crabs at its feet are already scuttling off in the shot), a shoal under the water plane to the right; (M3-CRE-616) five moths round a lamp on a low post close to the camera (lower right), and two dragonflies over the water's edge above the shoal (the near side of their patrol is inside flee_radius_m of the stand-in player, so one darts off to the far side). Same keys as a zone file; not a zone (zone ids it as wildlife_stage for the seed).
